Sombria.Label: Sombria — Blood and Ember
Sombria.Description: Gothic and infernal, in shades of purple. A fragment of Tenebra's domain.

ShowVitals.Name: Vitals panel
ShowVitals.Hint: The GM sees the Vigil panel: the Fear counter and each character's hit points, armor, hope and stress, in real time. Players see only the Fear counter. Available in themes that include the panel.

DefaultTheme.Name: World theme
DefaultTheme.Hint: Theme used by every player who has not picked another one.

Theme.Name: My theme
Theme.Hint: Theme used in this browser only. Follows the world theme by default.

Accent.Name: Accent color
Accent.Hint: Changes the theme's accent color for you only. Leave empty to use the theme's color.

ReduceEffects.Name: Reduce effects
ReduceEffects.Hint: Removes the glow and the cut corners. Useful on slower computers.

Variant.Name: Sphere floor
Variant.Hint: Visual variant of the Sombria theme for every player: each floor of the Sphere of Mysteries has its own palette, corners, texture and titles. A scene can set its own floor in the scene configuration.

SceneVariant.Name: Sphere floor (theme)
SceneVariant.Hint: While this scene is being viewed, the interface uses this floor of the Sombria theme. "Follow the world floor" uses the floor chosen in the module settings.

AnnounceVariant.Name: Announce floor changes
AnnounceVariant.Hint: Shows a card with the floor name when the GM changes floor or when the scene switches to a different floor.

Corte.Label: Floor 7 — The Court of Endless Night
Corte.Title: The Court of Endless Night
Corte.Subtitle: Hunger

Tribunal.Label: Floor 11 — The Tribunal of the Furies
Tribunal.Title: The Tribunal of the Furies
